title: Schema for Redundant BMC Configuration Files
description: Configuration schema for OpenBMC redundant BMC functionality

sibling_bmc_reset_gpio.description: GPIO configuration for resetting the sibling BMC

bmc_configs.description: Array of BMC configuration objects. Required when sibling_bmc_present_gpio is necessary, optional otherwise.

pcie_config.description: PCIe storage configuration for redundancy data. Optional - if not present, PCIe storage functionality is disabled.

polarity.description: The polarity of the GPIO line. 'low' means active when the GPIO reads low, 'high' means active when the GPIO reads high.

bmc_config.description: Configuration for a single BMC in the redundant system

bmc_pos.description: Position/index of this BMC (0-based). Typically 0 or 1 for dual BMC systems.

sibling_bmc_present_gpio.description: GPIO configuration for detecting sibling BMC presence

pcie_config.description: PCIe storage configuration for redundancy data

redundancy_offset.description: Offset in the PCIe device for redundancy data as a hex string (e.g., '0x3EFFF80')
